reason: COMPLEX. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and the 'Every batch lab-tested' line on the front, which is rare for TikTok Shop magnesium. A dollar a day with free shipping is fair, and sachets fit my gym bag, so I would try one box of the Complex and not stock up.
objection: Only 3 forms when other brands put 8 or 14 in one capsule, so I wonder if I am paying for packaging instead of more magnesium. I also want to see a real batch report before I believe it.
would_change_my_mind: A flash sale or coupon bringing a box under $25, or a batch report that opens fast and shows the magnesium content matches the label.
